tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. The brand's default surface. Dark is primary; light is for reports, print and the published standard.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: First raised layer: panels, table bands, the product sidebar.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Second raised layer: hover rows, popovers, input fills. Never a third layer on top of this.

tokens.name: stone
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and the column grid. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, outline buttons, table rules under headers. 3.3:1 or better on ground, surface and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and data on ground, surface and raised (14.5:1 or better in both themes). Also the solid button fill and the filled data mark.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: ledes, captions, table labels, mono eyebrows. 5.7:1 or better on ground, surface and raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: metadata, timestamps, disabled controls, tick marks. 4.6:1 or better on ground, surface and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an ink fill (solid buttons, selected chips, inverted bands).

tokens.name: data-mid
tokens.usage: The partial data mark: pillars in progress, the second series in a comparison. 3.7:1 or better against track.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Unfilled ticks, empty bars and gauge tracks. Ink and data-mid both hold 3:1 or better on it.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: Failed checks and form errors only, always paired with a word. Never decoration, never a pillar color. 5:1 or better on ground, surface and raised.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. 13:1 or better on every surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: One per page: the website hero, report covers. Sentence case.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles, table captions, dialog titles.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: A single score or measured figure. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: We measure whether women are safe at work and hold real decision-making power.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display line. One per section.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every finding names the pillar, the evidence and what changed.
styles.usage: Running text. Weight 300 only at 16px and above.

styles.name: body-s
styles.usage: Dense product text and table cells. Weight 400 below 16px, never 300.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, spec-table labels, clause numbers. Uppercase. Slash separates levels.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Values in spec tables and charts. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: clause
styles.usage: Clause and criterion numbers in the published standard.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label, dot to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and status marks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Spec-table row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Grid gutter (12 columns, 16px gap) and card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between a label and its content block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between components in a section.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop. Space is the luxury: do not compress it.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: buttons, inputs, cards, tables. The system is square.

tokens.name: radius-2
tokens.usage: Small interactive chips only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Status dots and the eyebrow dot. Never a container.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Rules, grid lines, table dividers, icon strokes at 16px.

tokens.name: stroke-mark
tokens.usage: Icons at 20px and up, dial ticks, outline Dagaz in the seal.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring width; offset is also 2px.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover and press states.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panels, reveals, dial fills. Easing cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

tokens.name: duration-slow
tokens.usage: One orchestrated moment per page at most: the hero line or the score reading in.
